outcomes.control_invalid: either Task-A or Task-B control pass count exceeds its preregistered maximum
outcomes.joint_confirmation_failed: controls remain valid but one or more Task-A/Task-B confirmation conditions fail
outcomes.joint_learnability_confirmed: all Task-A and Task-B joint_gate conditions pass with both controls valid

purpose: Confirm on fresh synthetic seeds that one fixed learner configuration with categorical-direction entropy 0.005 simultaneously satisfies account-conditioned action selection (Task A) and delayed consequence credit assignment (Task B) while matched controls remain invalid.

control.construction: every actual-account x observed-account pair appears equally; actual and observed account marginals are balanced and exactly independent
control.name: ACCOUNT_OBSERVATION_ZERO_RELATION
control.reward_physics: reward always comes from actual AccountTruth and sampled action; only policy-observed AccountState is zero-relation

task_a.market: identical flat OHLCV: prices 100, volume 10, one predecessor plus 64 represented bars
task_a.name: ACCOUNT_CONDITIONED_MAINTENANCE_JOINT_CONFIRMATION
task_a.positive_training_observation: policy observes the true AccountState derived from each actual AccountTruth

control.construction: within every generation, preserve all collected states/actions and the multiset of delayed step_1 rewards, but assign delayed rewards through a deterministic seed-and-generation-specific non-identity permutation before learner update
control.name: SHUFFLED_ACTION_TO_CONSEQUENCE

cue_market.down: represented closes fall exponentially from 100*exp(+0.04) to 100
cue_market.open: previous represented close; first represented open equals predecessor close
cue_market.up: represented closes rise exponentially from 100*exp(-0.04) to 100

task_b.name: DELAYED_CONSEQUENCE_CREDIT
task_b.positive_training: use each trajectory's own delayed step_1 log-equity reward

step_1.description: the position created by action_0 remains active through the gap before action_1 executes; with zero friction and close_2=open_2, action_1 has no contemporaneous economic effect
step_1.market: neutral flat OHLCV at price 100 and volume 10
